name: Lobbyist's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Selling a king captures a random enemy piece.
description: When you sell a king mid-run, a random non-boss enemy piece gets captured in return. A splice of Equivalent Exchange's sell trigger with Kamikaze's capture logic, priced as an epic. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
